product._comment: UI/product display params. morphoApyPct = Steakhouse Morpho native supply APY stub (NOT Merkl). Idle USDG Morpho on testnet stays this stub until a real sleeve. Full research table: contracts/config/mainnet.json. Layers in docs/V1_PARAMETERS.md.
product._idleSleeveNote: Testnet: CarryStrategy + MockMorphoVault wired; owner can deployIdle. Matched inventory uses DualPool. Real Steakhouse Morpho is still issue #20 mainnet work.
product._earlyExitFloorNote: Display stub only on v3.2 — no fixed coupon; lenders earn Morpho + Carry fees.
product.researchRangesNote: Research uses session-vol bands (±1× five-session); UI follows Maker until he picks.
product._launchMarketsNote: Markets the site lists for the Nov 2 mainnet launch (maker, 2026-10-19), from /mnt/project-files/launch/mainnet-markets.tsv. Site data only: on-chain market ids are assigned at deploy. testnetLive = has a vault market on testnet today (only MSTR). One shared USDG lender pool with no limit; no per-wallet cap.
product._marketRequestNote: Apps Script web app URL for the markets page request form (docs/market-requests/README.md). Empty = the form opens a prefilled GitHub issue.

caps._note: v3: seniorTotalUsd 0 = uncapped pool. Junior market $25k. perWalletUsd 0 unlimited. min $25.

product.morphoRateNote: v3.2-dualpool: no fixed morphoRateWad coupon. Matched USDG can sit in DualPool; idle can earn via CarryStrategy/MockMorpho after deployIdle.
product.usdgIdleApyNote: Testnet idle APY uses MockMorphoVault once deployIdle has run; mainnet Steakhouse sleeve is issue #20.

onChain._comment: v3.2-dualpool live PROXY. One-arg settle/earlyExit; DualPool + strategy wired.

product.gasCreditNote: Gas refund only when depositSenior actually matches; scaled to matched/deposited. See docs/GAS_CREDIT.md.
product.treasuryCutNote: Treasury cut % of fees. Base 20%. Boost tiers via setBoostHook (StrategyBoostHook), not setBoostStaked.
product.earlyExitCoverNote: v3.2: one-arg earlyExit (no CoverMode picker). Fee split at exit; no fixed accrual coupon.
product.settleCoverNote: v3.2: one-arg settle; healthy positions can roll at term; underwater+48h force-settle on upgraded impl.
product.autoCompoundNote: setAutoCompound(bool). Explicit withdrawUnmatched always wallet. Under $25 compound → wallet. Pause/caps do not brick exits.
product.accountingNote: v3.2 lender pool + DualPool for new matches. See docs/ACCOUNTING_V3.md and docs/testnet-runs/2026-10-18-v32-upgrade.md.
